items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; keep private and preview-only. Evidence shows Woot API access and rate limits, but current Woot terms restrict commercial/public listing, price, derivative, and data-mining use. Rights, privacy/data-flow, security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Do not send rights outreach or change the private gate without owner authorization and human-counsel review. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only if it adds no new data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, or cross-site behavior.

Compliance baseline is not certification: 35 sites pass, 20 fail, and 6 are unknown; open findings include consent-banner, accept/reject, GA4, privacy, and terms checks. Analytics is broadly configured and data quality is green except revenue attribution, which is yellow because $4.92 aggregate commission cannot be assigned to sites. Do not block ordinary growth solely for incomplete telemetry, but block new public exposure and monetization expansion where disclosures, rights, consent, or claims evidence is absent.

Keep the four SearchWoot launch-readiness legal tasks open. Next evidence action: produce one dated read-only bundle covering source rights/field permissions, alert-data flow and retention, deployed consent and GA4 settings, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Do not enable tracking, collect new data, send external outreach, or change production.
